definitions.gloss: center, middle, right in the middle
definitions.explanation: The exact center point of something. The {真|ま}ん emphasizes that it's the true/exact center.

examples.english: I placed flowers in the middle of the desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}ん{中|なか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}って→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please stand in the center of the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}ん{中|なか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}かないで→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't walk in the middle of the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}ん{中|なか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}って→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{笑|わら}って→笑う：00685_warau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please stand in the center of the photo and everyone smile.

examples.japanese: {真|ま}ん{中|なか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|あ}いています→空く：11062_aku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦そこ→そこ：00991_soko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}りましょう→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{遠|とお}い→遠い：00529_tooi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{見|み}やすい→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: The middle seat is empty, so let's sit there. It's far from the window, but I think it's easy to see from there.

notes:
{真|ま}ん{中|なか} emphasizes the exact center. The {真|ま}ん prefix means 'true/exact' and intensifies ⟦{中|なか}→{中|なか}：00654_naka⟧.

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{中|なか}→{中|なか}：00654_naka⟧:
- ⟦{中|なか}→{中|なか}：00654_naka⟧: inside, middle (general)
- {真|ま}ん{中|なか}: right in the center, dead center (exact)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}ん{中|なか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in the center of ~
- {真|ま}ん{中|なか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→{席|せき}：02215_seki⟧: the middle seat
- {真|ま}ん{中|なか}あたり: around the middle

OTHER {真|ま}ん〜 WORDS:
The {真|ま}ん prefix appears in other words emphasizing 'exactly/right':
- ⟦{真|ま}ん{前|まえ}→まんまえ：noentry⟧: right in front
- ⟦{真|ま}ん{丸|まる}い→真ん丸：19388_manmaru⟧: perfectly round
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{直|す}ぐ→まっすぐ：00866_massugu⟧: straight ahead
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}→{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}：07613_masshiro⟧: pure white
